summary: State synchronization bug fix verified. All 14 backend tests passed. Pipeline update_stage creates Match records when moving to matched/interviewing/offer_sent/hired stages. Match creation is idempotent. Pipeline candidates include match_id. accept_candidate syncs pipeline_stages. Seeker applications show 'matched' status with match_id when Match record exists.
